meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制Claude的记忆模式,让重要内容按场景自动记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望Claude按场景记住关键信息并提醒你
copy.tagline_en: Create custom memory modes so Claude tracks what matters by scenario
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Claude to remember key details per scenario and remind you

howto.what: 装好后,它会询问你的工作内容,定制 claude-mem 的笔记模式:设计观察类型与标签,经批准后安装激活,可选配 Telegram 提醒,最后重启并验证。
howto.when: 当你想让 claude-mem 改记别的内容时触发,比如新建或修改模式、增加观察类型或标签、对特定记忆开 Telegram 提醒等,即使没说「模式」。

say.text: 帮我给 claude-mem 建一个适合律师做笔记的模式。
say.note: 它会访谈你并给出观察类型与标签方案。

say.text: 增加一种观察类型,记录实验结论,并打上成本相关标签。
say.note: 它会更新模式并重启验证。

say.text: 让带「紧急」标签的记忆自动发 Telegram 提醒我。
say.note: 需要时它会引导配置机器人凭证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude asks about your work and customizes claude-mem's note-taking mode: it designs mutually exclusive observation types and reusable tags, installs and activates them after approval, optionally configures Telegram alerts, then restarts and verifies.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want claude-mem to remember different things, e.g. create or change a mode, add observation types or tags, or set up Telegram alerts for certain memories, even if you don't say "mode."

say_en.text: Set up a claude-mem mode for legal notes as a lawyer.
say_en.note: It interviews you and proposes observation types and tags.

say_en.text: Add an observation type recording experiment conclusions, tagged by cost themes.
say_en.note: It updates the mode and restarts to verify.

say_en.text: Send me a Telegram alert when a memory is tagged urgent.
say_en.note: It guides bot credential setup if needed.
